description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the performance accuracy of various reinforcement learning methods across three different tasks. The horizontal axis contains the categories, lacking a general axis title but featuring specific tick labels ordered from left to right as Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical value axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and utilizes a linear scale that begins at 50 and extends to 62, with tick labels and corresponding horizontal dashed grid lines at regular intervals of 2 units. For each of the three tasks, there is a cluster of six adjacent bars representing different methods, distinguished by color and hatching patterns as indicated in the legend located at the top. Within each group, the bars are consistently arranged from left to right: DAPO (light blue with diagonal stripes), DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), GRPO (light orange with diagonal stripes), SRPO (solid orange), PPO (light green with diagonal stripes), and PPO+Self-reflection (solid dark green). All bars are outlined in black, and the chart does not sort the bars by height, instead maintaining this fixed categorical sequence across all groups. The shortest bar in the chart represents the DAPO method in the Mathverse category, indicating an accuracy of approximately 53.1%, while the tallest bar represents the DAPO+Self-reflection method in the Physics category, reaching an approximate accuracy of 61.0%. Vertical dashed grid lines visually separate the three main task categories.
